name: BioClima CoverageJSON profile
abstract: Profile of the OGC CoverageJSON standard adopted by BioClima. Constrains the standard schema to require an EPSG:4326 spatial CRS, a multi-temporal axis when present, and ensures every parameter's observedProperty.id resolves to a SKOS concept inside the BioClima ontology. Used by every EBV and indicator dataset in the register.
